diagram_math_checks.objects: Two cap images of radius R in the common (x,y) coordinate view, at z=H and z=0.
diagram_math_checks.check: The Given formulas kappa_+(r,theta)=(r cos theta,r sin theta,H) and kappa_-(r,theta)=(r sin theta,r cos theta,0), with 0<=r<=R, give the indicated full discs. Equal circle sizes depict the same R and carry no numerical R:H scale claim.

At theta=0 or 2pi, kappa_+ maps to (r,0,H), while kappa_- maps to (0,r,0). Thus the upper ray is exactly +x and the lower exactly +y in the same coordinate view. Neither ray is a new boundary component.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Given, step 4.1; admissible-patch supplier permits seam identifications and polar rank loss on the parameter boundary.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Four strip bands sigma_0,...,sigma_3 with theta endpoints 0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2, 2pi and z endpoints 0,H.
diagram_math_checks.check: The bands are the supplied J_j x [0,H] domains, and their images under sigma_j(theta,z)=(R cos theta,R sin theta,z) are precisely the four lateral quarters. Adjacent strip edges map to shared vertical seams; theta=0 and theta=2pi have identical images. The strip is expressly a parameter-domain layout rather than a planar face of the solid.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Given and steps 1.1, 3.1; no additional seams or overlap interiors are asserted.
